entries.title: Psalms 103:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The eagles - Which lives long in great strength and vigour.

entries.title: Psalms 103:11
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: So great - So much above their deserts and expectations.

entries.title: Psalms 103:14
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Knoweth - The weakness and mortality of our natures, and the frailty of our condition, so that if he should let loose his hand upon us, we should be irrecoverably destroyed.

entries.title: Psalms 103:21
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: His hosts - A title often given to the angels, in regard of their vast numbers, mighty power, unanimous concurrence, and exquisite order. Ministers - This Hebrew word is commonly used of the highest and most honourable sort of servants,
